totalFinancialPosition:
The amount shown is indicative of the amount a customer may be able to use but may not be what should be available or is actually available.


The amount shown is indicative of the amount a customer may beable to use in their{productName} accounts added together. The amount shown may not be what should be available or is actually available.

This can be because, for example:
  • some transactions may not have updated the amountshown (e.g. reversals)
  • some transactions may have updated the amount shownbut are not yet fully processed (e.g. pending transactions),
  • we may not process transactions at the time, on theday or in the order that they are made, or
  • some transactions may have been processed and updated the amountshown, but are later adjusted.
    • If a customer proceeds with a transaction when there may beinsufficient funds, their account may go overdrawn or thetransaction may be declined.

    *This amount is only viewable by coaches and not available to the customer in the app.
